title: fd_butterworth
description: `fd_butterworth` is a 3-pole, 3-zero Butterworth low-pass, high-pass, or shelving filter. Set the low-pass frequency to 0 and normalization to 1 for high-pass operation, or set the high-pass frequency to at least half the sample rate and normalization to 0 for low-pass operation; the patch warns that it may produce loud output.
